text: Chapter 1. The Right to Be Rich

No matter what anyone says about how great poverty is, the truth is you can't live a truly complete or successful life unless you're rich. No one can reach their full potential in terms of talent or spiritual growth without plenty of money. That's because to develop your spirit and talent, you need a lot of things. And you can't get those things without money to buy them.
People grow in mind, spirit, and body by using things. Society is set up so that you need money to own things. So, the foundation for all human progress has to be the science of getting rich.
The whole point of life is to grow and develop. And everything alive has an undeniable right to reach its full potential.
Your right to life means you have the right to freely and fully use everything you need for your complete mental, spiritual, and physical growth. In other words, it's your right to be rich.

In this book, I'm not talking about riches in a symbolic way. Being truly rich doesn't mean being happy or content with just a little. No one should be satisfied with a little if they're capable of using and enjoying more. Nature's purpose is to advance and develop life. And everyone should have everything that can add to the power, elegance, beauty, and richness of their life. To be okay with less than that is wrong.

Someone is rich if they have everything they want to live the fullest life they're capable of. And no one without plenty of money can have everything they want. Life has progressed so much and become so complicated that even an average person needs a lot of wealth just to live a life that's even close to complete. Everyone naturally wants to become everything they're capable of being. This desire to fulfill our natural potential is built into human nature. We can't help but want to be all that we can be. Success in life means becoming who you want to be. You can only become who you want to be by using things. And you can only freely use things if you become rich enough to buy them. Therefore, understanding the science of getting rich is the most crucial knowledge of all.

There's nothing wrong with wanting to get rich. Wanting wealth is really wanting a richer, fuller, and more abundant life. And that desire is commendable. Someone who doesn't want to live more abundantly is abnormal. And so is someone who doesn't want enough money to buy everything they want.

We live for three main reasons: We live for our body, we live for our mind, and we live for our spirit. None of these is better or more sacred than the others; all are equally important. And none of the three—body, mind, or spirit—can live fully if either of the others is held back from full life and expression. It's not right or noble to live only for the spirit and ignore your mind or body. And it's wrong to live only for your intellect and ignore your body and spirit.

We all know the terrible results of living only for the body and neglecting both mind and spirit. And we see that real life means fully expressing everything a person can offer through their body, mind, and spirit. No matter what anyone says, no one can be truly happy or satisfied unless their body is fully functioning in every way, and the same goes for their mind and spirit. Wherever there's an unexpressed potential or a function not performed, there's an unsatisfied desire. Desire is potential looking for a way to be expressed, or a function looking to be performed.

You can't live fully in your body without good food, comfortable clothes, and warm shelter. You also need freedom from too much hard work. Rest and recreation are also essential for your physical well-being.
You can't live fully in your mind without books and time to study them. You also need opportunities to travel and observe, and intellectual companionship.
To live fully in your mind, you need intellectual activities. And you must surround yourself with all the art and beautiful things you're capable of using and appreciating.
To live fully in your spirit, you must have love. And poverty prevents love from being fully expressed.

A person's greatest happiness comes from giving benefits to those they love. Love expresses itself most naturally and spontaneously through giving. Someone who has nothing to give can't fulfill their role as a husband or father, as a citizen, or as a person. It's by using material things that people find a full life for their body, develop their mind, and grow their spirit. Therefore, it's incredibly important for them to be rich.

It's perfectly fine for you to want to be rich. If you're a normal person, you can't help but want that. It's perfectly right that you should pay close attention to the Science of Getting Rich, because it's the most noble and essential of all studies. If you ignore this study, you're failing in your duty to yourself, to God, and to humanity. That's because you can't do God or humanity a greater service than by making the most of yourself.
